issuing_body: National New Generation Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional Committee (国家新一代人工智能治理专业委员会), Ministry of Science and Technology of the People's Republic of China
covered_actors: Natural persons engaged in AI management, R&D, supply, or use activities
Legal persons engaged in AI management, R&D, supply, or use activities
Other relevant organizations engaged in AI management, R&D, supply, or use activities
prohibited_practices: Harming individuals' legitimate data rights and interests
Illegally collecting or using personal information through theft, tampering, leakage, or other means
Infringing upon individuals' right to privacy
implementation_notes: Non-binding ethical guideline issued to integrate ethics across the AI lifecycle and operationalize China's New Generation AI Development Plan and Governance Principles. Effective upon publication (2021-09-25) and subject to timely revision based on socioeconomic needs and AI development. Note that the provided text contains the release notice, Articles 2-3, and Article 25, while the 18 specific ethical requirements for management, R&D, supply, and use referenced in the preamble are omitted from this excerpt.
